name: 3-601 (Hubble)
blurb: 3-601, a red-sequence galaxy studied for signs of dry mergers, seen by Hubble.
label: 3601-hubble
story: Hubble looked at this galaxy to learn how "dry" mergers, collisions between red, bulge-dominated galaxies, help shape today's most massive elliptical galaxies.

claims.text: 3-601 is a target of Hubble program 10809, 'The nature of "dry" mergers in the nearby Universe'
The program images red sequence galaxies, including ongoing dry mergers, remnants and undisturbed objects
Dry mergers of red, bulge-dominated galaxies help shape today's most massive ellipticals
The Hubble sample of this program consists of bright, bulge-dominated red galaxies
